title: Landing — hero
description: The public homepage introduces the platform and provides Login/Create Account navigation.

title: Landing — quote illustration
description: A clearly labelled illustrative quote explains how routing, carrier selection, cost and margin can contribute to a quote. Figures shown are demo values.

title: Landing — feature cards
description: Feature cards introduce the SQL Copilot and the six operations modules: routing, quotes, carriers, weather, margin and customs.

title: Landing — four-step journey
description: The visitor workflow is summarized as entering requirements, agent review, pricing and reviewing a quote.

title: Landing — target users
description: Freight forwarders, shippers/exporters and analysts are shown as three audiences for the platform.

title: Landing — security
description: Highlights bcrypt password hashes, signed JWT sessions and email verification. Passwords are hashed, not reversibly encrypted.

title: Landing — FAQ
description: Frequently asked questions clarify basic use, roles, recovery and account creation before visitors sign in.

title: Sign-in — assigned role
description: Sign-in accepts username or email, the administrator-assigned role and password. Choosing a role does not assign or elevate permissions.

title: Copilot — example prompts
description: The administrator-facing Copilot shows suggested freight questions, a text field and a microphone input button.

title: Route AI — fleet map
description: A route analysis page displays ports, vessels, congestion and storm indicators on the world map.

title: Route AI — route planner
description: The planner accepts origin, destination and cargo; Plan Route computes options using the existing routing system.

title: Spot Quotes — new quote
description: An authorized operator selects origin, destination, cargo, weight, HS code and customer for the quote pipeline.

title: Copilot — SQL answers
description: Examples show a zero-row carrier lookup and a weather query with visible SQL/row counts and optional text-to-speech.

title: Spot Quotes — results
description: After quoting, the module displays quote counts and statuses, including approved and on-hold records.

title: Spot Quotes — history and tickets
description: Users can review recent quotes and open tickets describing holds that need attention.

title: Carriers — ranking
description: The carrier league table compares scores, on-time performance, cost index, risk and shipment counts.

title: Weather Risk — overview
description: The module summarizes weather provider freshness, monitored ports, storms and vessel/port risk.

title: Weather Risk — world map
description: Interactive weather and maritime markers are color-coded by wind and storm risk.

title: Weather Risk — data sources
description: Port weather is sourced from Open-Meteo; the page distinguishes that feed from simulated vessel positions and modeled congestion.

title: Weather Risk — storm test
description: Inject Storm adds a *simulation* for testing reroute behavior; it is not a real weather alert.

title: Margin — overview
description: Pricing totals and thresholds show average margin, low-margin quotes, high-value quotes and revenue represented in quotes.

title: Margin — cost build-up
description: The chosen quote is broken into base cost, fuel, customs, insurance, margin and total, with an accompanying chart.

title: Customs — held shipments
description: Customs shows active rules and a list of shipments or quotes on hold because documents are missing.

title: Customs — rules and documents
description: HS-chapter rules identify required documents; the attachment UI supports submitting relevant documents against a hold.

title: Profile — admin summary
description: The administrator profile displays role, joined date and last login, as well as an authenticated username-change form.

title: Profile — credential update
description: Profile security settings permit password changes after confirmation of the current password.

title: Admin — account statistics
description: The Admin Dashboard summarizes total, active and locked accounts, and provides a create-user form with role assignment.

title: Admin — account management
description: The user table contains role, state, customer mapping and login metadata with controls for permitted management actions. Email column is redacted.

title: Admin — audit log and role matrix
description: The audit log records administrative events; the role matrix shows per-module permissions. Email fragments are redacted.

title: Customer — scoped Copilot
description: Customer prompts focus on that customer’s shipments, recent quotes and cargo location; answers must respect account scope.

title: Customer — My Quotes
description: Customers see only linked quote records and corresponding statuses in the My Quotes view.

title: Customer — profile
description: A Customer profile shows its assigned customer identifier and account settings. Personal email is redacted.

title: Freight Broker — carriers
description: Freight Broker access includes carrier comparison and risk metrics, without admin controls.

title: Freight Broker — margins
description: Freight Broker can review pricing breakdowns and profit-margin information according to its role permissions.

title: Freight Broker — profile
description: The profile reflects the assigned Freight Broker role. Personal email is redacted.

title: Freight Broker — quotations
description: The freight quotation entry form is available to the Freight Broker with a role-appropriate sidebar.

title: Operations Manager — route
description: Operations Manager sees Route AI and can examine the modeled congestion and live-fleet view.

title: Operations Manager — weather
description: The operations-focused Weather Risk view includes port and storm information without pricing screens.

title: Operations Manager — customs
description: Customs review is available in Operations Manager’s navigation, with customs rule and held-shipment data.

title: Operations Manager — profile
description: The profile confirms Operations Manager access and supports username/password maintenance. Personal email is redacted.

title: Auditor — route view
description: Auditor can inspect route data without a Run Analysis action, illustrating read-only access.

title: Auditor — customs view
description: Auditor sees customs status and document requirements for review purposes.

title: Auditor — documents
description: The document tab lists generated PDFs and an upload/extraction interface; authorization still controls whether actions are accepted.

title: Auditor — profile
description: An Auditor account is labelled read-only in the access model; profile credentials can still be maintained. Personal email is redacted.

title: Registration — customer
description: Public self-registration collects username, email, strong password and security question/answer. New accounts are Customers by default.

title: Registration — email verification
description: A six-digit email code verifies a new account before first sign-in. The example email is redacted.

title: Recovery — email OTP
description: Forgot-password supports time-limited email OTP recovery and resend throttling; the example email is redacted.

title: Recovery — security question
description: The alternative recovery path displays the saved question and checks the answer without revealing it. The account identifier is redacted.

title: Recovery — rate limiting
description: Rate limiting protects repeated OTP attempts; the submitted email and test code are redacted.

title: Locked account — clear error
description: Locked users receive the explicit account-locked message rather than a misleading session-expired error. The login identifier is redacted.
